name: What are common signs that my appliance gas line needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my appliance gas line needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several indicators suggest a potential issue with your appliance gas line. A distinct sulfur or 'rotten egg' smell is the most critical sign of a gas leak and requires immediate attention. Other signs include a hissing or whistling sound near the gas line, a visible crack or damage to the line itself, or appliances not functioning correctly due to insufficient gas supply. If you notice any of these, it's important to contact a qualified professional to inspect and address the problem promptly to ensure safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs include a rotten egg smell, hissing sounds, visible damage, or appliance malfunction. Prompt professional inspection is crucial for safety.
